title: Belgian railway stations: accessibility facilities (iRail)
description: About 580 NMBS/SNCB stations in Belgium with accessibility facilities from the iRail stations repository: wheelchairs available, boarding ramp, lift to the platforms, escalators, induction loop, number of disabled parking spaces and platform height. 557 stations have facility data; null means unknown. wheelchair_available, ramp and audio_induction_loop were last published by NMBS in June 2023 and may be outdated; lift and escalator data come from OpenStreetMap. NMBS's own GTFS has no wheelchair data, so this is the source for train stations.
licence_note: The repository is CC0, but lift and escalator fields derive from OpenStreetMap (ODbL, share-alike), a conflict the repository itself flags as unresolved; platform heights come from Infrabel (CC0).

conforms_to.title: iRail stations: stations.csv and facilities.csv columns (README)

assessment.note: Station facilities published by NMBS/SNCB, collected in the iRail stations repository (a volunteer project); some fields were last published in June 2023.
